UNCEASING_TOP.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Confidence[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CORONET.title: Little Coronet
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CORONET.description:
At the start of the first turn, gain [blue]{Smoke}[/blue] [gold]Smoke[/gold].
Cards that would be discarded at the end of your turn are discarded at the end of the enemy turn instead.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_SHINING_CROWN.title: Shining Crown
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_SHINING_CROWN.descrip:
At the start of each turn, gain [blue]{Smoke}[/blue] [gold]Smoke[/gold].
Cards that would be discarded at the end of your turn are discarded at the end of the enemy turn instead.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_BLACK_CAT.title: Black Cat
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_BLACK_CAT.description: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{BlackCatSeal}[/blue] [gold]Black Cat's Mark[/gold] to ALL enemies.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CALICO_CAT.title: Calico Cat
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CALICO_CAT.descriptio: Whenever you [gold]create[/gold] a card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_PHOTOGRAPH.title: Photograph
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_PHOTOGRAPH.descriptio: Attacks deal additional damage equal to the number of [gold]Keywords[/gold] they have.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CAMERA.title: Camera
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CAMERA.description: In each card reward, a random card gains the [gold]Keepsake[/gold] [gold]Keyword[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_INCENSE.title: Incense
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_INCENSE.description: Once per combat, right-click this relic to shuffle all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into your Draw Pile, then draw the same number of cards.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_VOUCHER.title: Voucher
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_VOUCHER.description: Your next [blue]{Purchases}[/blue] shop purchases cost no Gold.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_OLD_DIARY.title: Old Diary
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_RELIC_FRAGMENT.title: Relic Fragment
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_RELIC_FRAGMENT.descri: When taken from a [gold]combat reward[/gold], if you have at least [blue]3[/blue] Relic Fragments, remove all Relic Fragments and obtain a random Relic.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_MAGIC_MIRROR.title: Magic Mirror
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_MAGIC_GLOVES.title: Magic Gloves
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_MAGIC_GLOVES.descript: After combat, add a reward to the combat rewards. When taken, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Transformable cards from among all such cards in your Deck and Transform them.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_MAGIC_GLOVES.rewardDe: Choose [blue]2[/blue] Transformable cards from among all such cards in your Deck and [gold]Transform[/gold] them.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CAT_IN_BOX.title: Cat in the Box
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CAT_IN_BOX.descriptio: After you play your [blue]third[/blue] card each turn, choose any number of cards in your Hand to [gold]Transform[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CAT_IN_BOX.selectionS: Choose any number of cards in your Hand to [gold]Transform[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_SEALED_TREASURE_CHEST:
Choose and obtain any {Cards:diff()} different cards from your character's card pool.
Your future [gold]combat rewards[/gold] no longer contain [gold]card rewards[/gold].
Choose {Cards} different cards to add to your Deck.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CRYSTAL_BALL.title: Crystal Ball
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_CRYSTAL_BALL.descript: [gold]Enchant[/gold] Common cards in your Deck and future [gold]card rewards[/gold] with [purple]Iridescent[/purple].
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_BOOK_AND_PEN.title: Book and Pen
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_BOOK_AND_PEN.descript:
You can now add the [gold]Keepsake[/gold] Keyword to a card at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
The first time you choose [gold]Write in Diary[/gold], it does not consume a Rest Site action.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_BOOK_AND_PEN.writeDia: Add the [gold]Keepsake[/gold] Keyword to a card in your Deck.
Choose a card to gain the [gold]Keepsake[/gold] Keyword.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_MAGIC_WAND.title: Magic Wand
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_MAGIC_WAND.descriptio: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, apply [blue]1[/blue] additional stack.
At the start of each combat, [red]lose[/red] [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
At the start of each turn, if you have an empty potion slot, obtain a random Potion. Discard it at the end of the turn or combat.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_OVERTURNED_TEA_SET.de: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Special Party[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_DRINK_COUPON.title: Drink Coupon
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_DRINK_COUPON.descript:
Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] empty potion slots (up to [blue]{MaxPotionSlots}[/blue]).
Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], fill your empty potion slots with random Potions.
JANUS_SPIRE2_RELIC_DRINK_COUPON.addition: Fill your empty potion slots with random Potions.
